About the house

Located in the exclusive and prestigious area of Drautto, on the enchanting island of Panarea, stands a wonderful detached villa on two floors, completely independent on all four sides.

The villa, built in the classic Aeolian architectural style, has large terraces and outdoor spaces that offer a breathtaking view of the rocks of Lisca Bianca, Dattilo, Basiluzzo and the island of Stromboli, creating an atmosphere of pure beauty and relaxation.

The property consists of a living room, a kitchen, five bedrooms and three bathrooms. The floors of the galleries are ceramics dating back to the 1960s in perfect condition. The property also has a small outbuilding used as a pantry and laundry room.

The large garden, paved with Beole di Basiluzzo, which surrounds the villa, is an oasis of tranquillity and peace, adorned with plants and flowers typical of the area. Located in a privileged position, this property represents an exclusive opportunity for those looking for a unique and fascinating environment.
